transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to keep it light at first. Avoid heavy work or lifting for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops or treatment before your operation, it’s safe to continue using them unless you were told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside is fine.

But strong pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is also red and painful, and we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside is fine.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, but should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after the operation, and it should improve and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I think you've answered all my questions. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you very much!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn "Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside is fine." However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed at any point in the conversation.
